adjudication.rationale: In TopicEmbed.import, the code appends HTML containing an interpolated `url` directly into `contents` (`"#{url}"`). The post is created with `cook_method: Post.cook_methods[:raw_html]`, and `Post#cook` returns `raw` for `raw_html`, bypassing the normal cooking/sanitization pipeline. The embed view renders `raw post.cooked`, so any injected attributes/HTML will execute. The diff also shows `embed_url` is attacker-controlled via `EmbedController#best` params and can reach `TopicRetriever`/`TopicEmbed.import_remote` as long as `URI(@embed_url).host` matches `SiteSetting.embeddable_host`; a URL with a single quote in the query can still have the same host and satisfy `/^https?:\/\//`, enabling stored XSS via the unescaped href/text interpolation.
